lean.key_theorem: LemmaN.S_neg (line 1, identity in Z[q,q^-1]) and LemmaN.V_neg / LemmaN.V_neg_set (line 2)
lean.faithfulness_note: S_j is the recurrence S_{i+1}=[c_{i+1}]S_i-q^(c_i-1)S_{i-1}, (S_0,S_1)=(0,1), exponent on the previous quotient, [c]_q=(1-q^c)/(1-q) for all integers c, in Z[q,q^-1]; smoke-tested in Lean on the word (2,2,2) giving [4]_q. Line 1 is proved as a Laurent-polynomial identity S(-w)=(-q^-1)^(j-1)*S(w)(q->q^-1) and also in evaluated form at every unit of C (S_neg_ev). Line 2 V_j(k)=-V_j(k) is proved for residue words with Phi_k dividing S in Z[q,q^-1], for k>1 as in the write-up (statement.tex says all k; the integer-word form S_neg_dvd_iff holds for every k>=1). Lift independence of V (the write-up's residue-only lemma) is also proved (S_dvd_residue). Complex primitive roots appear only inside proofs (Phi_k divides f iff f(w)=0, via the minimal polynomial over Z).
lean.build_command: lake build Algebra.LemmaN (sandbox project requiring Mathlib v4.29.1)
